Metadata.title: Reevun
Metadata.description: Dashboard for the Reevun Discord bot, built for RP communities.

BetaBanner.message: Reevun is in beta — the product isn't fully finished yet, expect bugs and changes.

Hero.title: Run your Discord community
Hero.subtitle: Reevun handles recruitment, ranks, warnings, and tickets for your family. One sign-in with Discord, access limited to your own community.

Features.heading: Everything the bot manages, now in your browser too

items.title: Recruitment without the busywork
items.body: New members fill out an application, the bot screens out bots and spam on its own, and an AFK-aware profile builds itself along the way.

items.title: Ranks advance in order
items.body: The next rank only unlocks after the previous one, and after a third warning the role is removed automatically - no one has to do it by hand.

items.title: Tickets don't get lost
items.body: Every ticket gets its own number, with the full conversation right there in the dashboard.

items.title: Move people in one click
items.body: The /move command moves every selected member into a different voice channel at once.

items.title: See who did what
items.body: Granting a rank, clearing a warning, closing a ticket - every action stays in the log.

items.title: One account, every family
items.body: Running more than one server? Switch between them without signing in again.

HowItWorks.heading: Three steps to your first shift

steps.body: Install Reevun on your Discord server - you'll need administrator permissions.
Log in with your Discord account, no separate password required.
Ranks, warnings, and tickets, all in one place.

items.q: Do I need to host the bot myself?
items.a: No. The bot runs on our infrastructure - you only need to add it to your Discord server and sign in to the dashboard with the same account.

items.q: Who can see a family in the dashboard?
items.a: Only members with the "Manage Server" permission or administrator rights on that Discord server. Everyone else can't see the dashboard.

items.q: Can I manage more than one server from one account?
items.a: Yes. Reevun was built for multiple families from day one: one Discord account switches between every server where you have permission and the bot is installed.

items.q: Do I need a separate password for the dashboard?
items.a: No, sign-in is Discord OAuth only. There's no separate password for the site.
In a dedicated channel on your server. Before submitting, the form screens the applicant for bots and spam.

items.q: What happens after a third warning?
items.a: The role is removed automatically, without a moderator having to step in - no need to track it by hand.

items.q: Can I move members between voice channels?
items.a: Yes, with /move - several members at once, in a single action, no dragging each one manually.

items.q: Can I see who granted a rank or cleared a warning?
items.a: Yes, every such action is saved to the log and shown in the dashboard along with who did it.

items.q: The bot isn't responding - what do I do?
items.a: Check status.reevun.app - it shows which Reevun services are currently up and which aren't.

sections.heading: 1. What data we collect
sections.body:
When you sign in with Discord OAuth, the Service receives from Discord: your account ID, username, avatar, and the list of servers you manage. The Service does not request access to your email address, payment details, or Discord direct messages.

Data about members, ranks, warnings, and tickets for a specific Discord server is collected by the Bot itself on that server and stored in Reevun's database, scoped to that server's ID.

sections.heading: 2. How we use your data
sections.body:
Your Discord account data is used solely for authentication and to determine which families (servers) you can manage through the dashboard.

Data collected by the Bot on a given server is used to display and manage that server's features, and is visible only to users with administrative rights on that server.

sections.heading: 3. Storage and security
sections.body: Data is stored in PostgreSQL and Redis databases hosted on Railway's infrastructure. The connection to the site is secured with HTTPS encryption. Your session is stored in a signed cookie that cannot be forged without the Service's secret key.

sections.heading: 4. Sharing data with third parties
sections.body: The Service does not sell or share personal data with third parties for advertising purposes. The only party the Service communicates with is Discord itself, which is required for authentication to work. The Service does not use third-party advertising networks or analytics.

sections.heading: 5. Cookies
sections.body: The Service uses cookies required for signing in and remembering your chosen interface language. The full list and purpose of these cookies is described in a separate Cookie Policy.

sections.heading: 6. Your rights
sections.body:
You can revoke the Service's access to your Discord account at any time from Discord's Authorized Apps settings - this immediately stops the Service from being able to request your account data.

To request deletion of data stored in Reevun's database (for example, ticket history), reach out through the Support section on the site.

sections.heading: 7. Age requirements
sections.body: The Service is intended for users who meet the minimum age required by Discord's own Terms of Service. We do not knowingly collect data from users who do not meet this requirement.

sections.heading: 8. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this policy from time to time. The current version is always available on this page; for significant changes, we may additionally notify users through the site.

sections.heading: 1. Terms and definitions
sections.body: "Service" means the reevun.app website and the Reevun Discord bot dashboard. "Bot" means the Reevun application added to a Discord server. "Family" means a Discord server the Bot is installed on. "User" means any person who has signed in to the Service through Discord. "Family owner" means a user with the "Manage Server" permission or administrator rights on a given Discord server. "Operator", "we" means Reevun Software LLC.

sections.heading: 2. Subject of the agreement
sections.body:
Reevun is a dashboard for the Reevun Discord bot, built for RP communities. The Service lets Discord server owners and administrators manage member ranks, support tickets, and other Bot features through a web interface, without needing to use text commands in Discord.

Using the Service means full and unconditional acceptance of these Terms.

sections.heading: 3. Sign-in and authorization
sections.body: Signing in to the Service is done exclusively through Discord OAuth - there is no separate registration, login, or password. By signing in with Discord, you grant the Service access to basic public information from your Discord account and the list of servers you manage, solely so we can show you the families where the Bot is installed and you have management rights. The Service does not request or store your Discord account password.

sections.heading: 4. User rights and obligations
sections.body: The User agrees to use the Service only for lawful purposes and in accordance with Discord's Terms of Service; not to attempt to disrupt the Service, bypass access restrictions, or gain unauthorized access to other servers' data; and to bear sole responsibility for decisions made while managing their own family.

sections.heading: 5. Operator rights and obligations
sections.body: The Operator aims to keep the Service running but does not guarantee uninterrupted operation (see "Disclaimer of warranties" below). The Operator may change the functionality of the Service and the Bot, and may restrict or suspend access for individual users or servers that violate these Terms, Discord's Terms of Service, or applicable law.

sections.heading: 6. Data created by family owners
sections.body: Data about ranks, warnings, tickets, and other internal processes on a given Discord server is created and managed by that server's owner and administrators on their own. The Operator is not responsible for the content, accuracy, or consequences of decisions made by server members using the Bot's features.

sections.heading: 7. Intellectual property
sections.body: The Reevun name, logo, and the Service's and Bot's source code are the property of Reevun Software LLC. Reevun is not affiliated with or endorsed by Discord Inc., nor by Take-Two Interactive, Rockstar Games, or any other GTA rights holder - see the disclaimer in the site footer for more.

sections.heading: 8. Disclaimer of warranties
sections.body:
8.1. THE SERVICE IS PROVIDED "AS IS" AND "AS AVAILABLE", WITHOUT ANY GUARANTEE OF UNINTERRUPTED OR ERROR-FREE OPERATION.
8.2. THE OPERATOR MAY SUSPEND OR RESTRICT ACCESS TO THE SERVICE AT ANY TIME, INCLUDING FOR MAINTENANCE.
8.3. THE OPERATOR DOES NOT GUARANTEE THE PERSISTENCE OF DATA CREATED IN THE SERVICE AND RECOMMENDS THAT FAMILY OWNERS KEEP IMPORTANT RECORDS OUTSIDE THE SERVICE AS WELL.
8.4. THE OPERATOR IS NOT LIABLE FOR ACTIONS TAKEN BY USERS THROUGH THE SERVICE'S FEATURES, NOR FOR THE CONTENT OF THIRD-PARTY RESOURCES THAT MAY BE LINKED FROM WITHIN THE SERVICE.
8.5. THE USER USES THE SERVICE AT THEIR OWN RISK AND IS SOLELY RESPONSIBLE FOR THE CONSEQUENCES OF MANAGEMENT DECISIONS MADE THROUGH THE SERVICE.

sections.heading: 9. Termination of access
sections.body: The Operator may restrict or terminate a user's access to the Service for violating these Terms, or if the Bot is removed from a server or the user revokes Discord OAuth permissions. The user may revoke the Service's access to their Discord account at any time through Discord's Authorized Apps settings.

sections.heading: 10. Changes to these terms
sections.body: The Operator may amend these Terms unilaterally. The current version is always available on this page. Continuing to use the Service after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the new version.

sections.heading: 11. Contact
sections.body: For questions about these Terms, please reach out through the Support section on the site.

Cookies.title: Cookie Policy
Cookies.intro: We try to use as few cookies as possible - only what's actually necessary for the site to work.

sections.heading: 1. What cookies are
sections.body: Cookies are small text files a site stores in your browser to remember information between visits, such as the fact that you're already signed in.

sections.heading: 2. Required (technical) cookies
3. Functional cookies
sections.body: - NEXT_LOCALE - remembers your chosen interface language for about 1 year.

sections.heading: 4. Browser local storage
sections.body: Besides cookies, the site uses your browser's localStorage to remember that you've already closed the disclaimer and cookie notices on the homepage. This data stays only in your browser and is never sent to the server.

sections.heading: 5. Advertising and analytics cookies
sections.body: The Service does not use third-party advertising networks, analytics, or trackers.

sections.heading: 6. Managing cookies
sections.body: You can restrict or delete cookies in your browser's settings. Note that disabling required cookies will make signing in with Discord impossible.

sections.heading: 7. Changes to this policy
sections.body: We may update this page as the technology we use changes. The current version is always available here.
